_doc: Data tables for the strict function truth audit (backend/showme/audit/truth.py). Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-07-foundation-and-function-audit-design.md section 2.
_placeholder_doc: Matching is key-scoped (key regex + exact value), so ordinary constants such as 252 or 365 never match and no separate literal allow-list is needed. scope: where a rule applies (source = AST defaults, response = served values); default both.

canary._doc: Network-free, instant function used to tell a stalled sidecar from a slow function.

_calendar_doc: Calendar/forecast functions: future dates are legitimate and freshness is not judged.

placeholder_allow._doc: Per-function keys where a matching value is a documented convention (backtest initial capital normalised to 10,000).

_notes.finra_ats_weekly: FINRA OTC Transparency publishes weekly ATS data with a 2-week (Tier 1 NMS) or 4-week (other) delay, so the newest week is up to ~5-6 weeks old by rule.
